summary: The bank Silverline works end to end and passes 13 in-game suites (225 checks, 0 red errors) plus 91 unit tests. You can open an account at one of six banks via the comms console ("Call Silverline"), an ATM or a bank counter. Deposits take silver from storage or the trade beacon, withdrawals arrive by drop pod or instantly at an ATM. The account earns interest from the profitability slider (default 1.2 per 60-day year), and the night safe and direct deposit empty the tills into the account at midnight. Loans run on 5-day instalments and the collection ladder is capped by difficulty (stage 4 on Standard Room). The bank balance counts towards the storyteller wealth, and the mood thought, the research (free basic level, three projects, "research off" switch), about 25 settings and the Too Big To Fail bailout are all in. The window (lobby, loans, history, terms plus tabs from other modules) was checked visually through screenshots. Not done: routing vanilla trade income to the account, colonists using ATMs on their own, and the 1.6/1.5 builds (foundation build error, not tested). The comms-console entry, the Black Ledger gating and the real seizure/raid spawn (stages 5-7) are test-covered.
implemented: SL_BankDef (Silverline.SL_BankDef) and Bank_Banks.xml: six banks (Silverline Mutual, First Rim Bank of Too Big To Fail, Imperial Treasury [Royalty], Orbital Exchange [Odyssey], The Black Ledger [Underworld module on AND UnderworldDiscovered], First Church of Compound Interest [Ideology]) with fees, interestMod, loanSpread, slogans, perks and iconPath UI/HH/Bank/Logo_<defName>

BankGameComp (GameComponent, saved): colony account bank:colony, bank:transit, bank:loans; open account; switch bank for 50 silver (setting); history samples for the chart; BankImpl sets BankApi.Impl; BankTillSink sets Tills.BankSink (direct deposit setting, default on, fee setting default 0.5 %)

Interest: daily factor M^(1/60), M from bank.profit (log interpolation of the 7 tier anchors 100/2.0/1.5/1.2/1.0/0.7/0.1 until the player overrides it), times bank.accountBeta (default 1.0) and the bank's interestMod; negative interest and M=0 work; per-quadrum account fee; Black Ledger 1 % per quadrum seizure risk (25 % of the balance); Too Big To Fail bailout (interest-free 60-day loan, once per game year, max 10 % of the 60-day peak)

Deposit/withdraw: silver from beacon range or storage (never forbidden); deposit instant at counter/ATM else after 1 h (money in bank:transit); withdraw instantly at ATM (2 + 1 %, 500/day limit) or counter, otherwise drop pods after 2-12 h (1 %, min 5); every fee scales with bank.feeFactor

Buildings: SL_ATM (Graphic_Multi 1x1, powered), SL_BankCounter (Graphic_Multi 3x1, powered), SL_NightSafe (Graphic_Single 1x1, no power, CompProperties_TillSpot, direct-deposit toggle gizmo), JobDef SL_UseBank + JobDriver, designation category HH_Bank, comms console entry 'Call Silverline' via a Harmony postfix on Building_CommsConsole.GetCommTargets

Window_Bank: walnut/brass/green lobby; open-account page with all banks, slogans and perks; tab strip from BankTabs (lobby, loans, history, terms registered here); rolling balance, 30-day chart, deposit/withdraw with slider + number field + presets, recent activity, bank strip with direct-deposit toggle and Window_ChooseBank, Clerk Ottoline quips, 5-decimal history and tooltips with formulas on every number

Loans: Ledger Score 300-850, credit limit from balance + a quarter of colony wealth + score + starter credit, annuity instalments every 5 days, rate = max(2 %, M-1) + bank spread (variable with the slider), repay, caretaker check for the loan ledger

Collection ladder 1-7 (days 1/4/7/10/15/20/30): reminder letter, late fee + score -30, 50 % offset against deposits and blocked credit, two unarmed bowler-hat visitors of the hidden faction SL_CollectionsAgency who stand around (-2 mood nearby, leave when paid), seizure team with allow/refuse dialog (120 % of the debt in valuables), collection raid, bounty (raid x1.5); capped by bank.maxCollectionStage (anchors 0,1,2,4,5,6,7); Comped quietly defers instalments
Wealth: Harmony postfix on Map.PlayerWealthForStoryteller adds the balance (+ in transit) x bank.wealthShare (0-150 %), spread over player maps by map wealth, skipped in fixed-wealth mode

Mood: ThoughtDefs SL_Finances (ascetic/greedy nullified) and SL_FinancesGreedy (doubled) by net-worth tier with the one-day hold, setting bank.moodOn, tier thresholds scaled by bank.moodScale and colonists/3

Research: ResearchProjectDefs SL_Banking (ATM, night safe), SL_Branches (counter), SL_Credit (loans) in tab HH_Banking; account via comms console is free; bank.researchMode=Off completes them (caretaker)

Pure finance maths Source/Hearth.Core/Pure/Finance/FinanceMath.cs (deterministic exp/ln/pow, yields, annuity, score, limits, ladder stages, wealth tiers, bailout, fees) with 91 unit tests (Source/Tests/FinanceTests.cs)

In-game suites: bank.account, bank.interest, bank.withdraw, bank.sink, bank.loan, bank.collect, bank.wealth, bank.mood, bank.ui, bank.save, bank.buildings, bank.banks, plus bank.shots (manual screenshots, not in normal runs)

Settings UI: bank.profit is a log-scale value (0.01 to 100, 0 allowed): the generic linear slider should offer log scaling for it; Settings also has TierAnchors interpolated linearly whereas Bank M uses log interpolation (BankSettings.ProfitM does this itself)
If the integrator wants the key HH.Bank.* texts of other modules in my Keyed file, they must use their own HH_<Module>.xml; HH_Bank.xml is generated from code and must not be edited by hand
Core could expose a tick-independent 'midnight' event; the sink currently relies on Tills.FlushAll in HearthGame (works, tested through a real midnight)
integration_notes: Defs other modules may use: DesignationCategoryDef HH_Bank (defined in Common/Defs/Bank/Bank_Buildings.xml: the insurance agent must NOT define it again), ResearchProjectDefs SL_Banking, SL_Branches, SL_Credit in tab HH_Banking, ThingDefs SL_ATM, SL_BankCounter, SL_NightSafe, FactionDef SL_CollectionsAgency, SL_BankDef bank defs

BankTabs: built-in tab orders lobby 10, loans 20, history 30, terms 40; insurance/investments/lottery should register with order 50 and up. The window wraps tab Draw in Guard.Run and sets Window_Bank.Active (Map, Site, At) for tabs that need the current map or building

Ledger accounts: bank:colony, bank:transit, bank:loans (negative = debt). Other modules should not post to bank:colony directly: use BankApi.Impl.Deposit/Withdraw or BankGameComp.Current.Credit (applies fee, collection offset and keeps the ledger balanced)
BankGameComp.Current is the saved component (Silverline.BankGameComp, GameComponent); everything is saved in it, no fields on vanilla classes; module removal leaves ledger entries only

Harmony patches: Patch_CommsConsole_Targets (Building_CommsConsole.GetCommTargets postfix) and Patch_PlayerWealth (Map.PlayerWealthForStoryteller getter postfix with re-entrancy guard); both return early when Modules.On(Bank) is false
